info.title: Label_Endpoint
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

counter_id.description: The counter id being allocated for packet counters which are  being transmitted with MPLS label(s).

endpoint-type.description:
Reference Resource: [Label_Endpoint](#/Label_Endpoint)
Provides the allocated Label Endpoints 'entry': indicates Label Endpoint associated for Entry LSP 'transit': indicates Label Endpoint associated for Transit LSP

forwarding_state.description: The forwarding state for the  Label Endpoint entry

l3_destination_index.description: It provides L2 encapsulations in dataplanes that can abstract them, The contents in abstraction define the MAC address and Port information for the local nexthop.

label_destination_index.description: Certain dataplanes do need an extra L3 destination to be setup for transit cases that needs to be programmed into dataplane. This is valid only in those cases and specifically for Transit cases.

label_encap_attributes.description: MPLS attributes that will be used in configuing the transit or egress label bindings.

inherit_exp_from_dscp.description: Indicates whether EXP value can be inherited from DSCP values of native packet.

inherit_exp_from_pcp.description: Indicates whether EXP value can be inherited from PCP values native packet.

inherit_ttl.description: Indicates whether TTL value can be inherited from incomig label or native packet.

insert_entropy.description: Indicates whether Entropy labels need to inserted for egress traffic.

qos_mapping_table_id.description: The table ID used for obtatining the QoS re-map for transit or egress MPLS bindings.

use_qos_mapping_table.description: Indicates whether whether to use the QoS mapping table for this transit or entry MPLS bindings.

label_operation.description: The action specified by the Label Endpoint entry

lsp_type.description: Type of Label Switch Path 'transport'       : Indicates the Label Endpoint associated with transport 'l3-vpn'          : Indicates that the Label Endpoint carries l3-vpn service 'l2-vpn'          : Indicates that the Label Endpoint carries l2-vpn service

mac.description: MAC address learned for the local nexthop. This will be populated for platforms that need explicite programming of the l2_details as part of MPLS encapsulation.

mpls_index.description: The index specifies the dataplane index that represents specific Label(s) encapsulation. This is needed to define the label operation and Label values.

phy_port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Phy port corresponding to the local nexthop. This will be populated for platforms that need explicite programming of the l2_details as part of MPLS encapsulation.

port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
L3 port corresponding to the local nexthop. This will be populated for platforms that need explicite programming of the l2_details as part of MPLS encapsulation.

service_labels.description: Label values that the control plane has exchanged with its peer for carrying the service. This value will be populated only in cases where there is service abstraction possible in the data plane.

mpls_pkt_tx.description: Number of packets transmitted with MPLS label(s).

mpls_pkt_tx_octets.description: Number of octets/bytes transmitted with MPLS label(s).

statistics_clear_performed.description: Number of times the statistics were cleared for  packets and octets/bytes transmitted with MPLS label(s).

statistics_clear_requested.description: Number of times a request was made to clear statistics for  packets and octets/bytes transmitted with MPLS label(s).

transport_label.description: Indicates the outermost label for the Label Switch Path. presented in the dataplane.

parameters.name: Label_Switch_Path.out_label
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Label_Switch_Path](#/Label_Switch_Path)
Indicates the outgoing label for the Label Switch Path.

parameters.name: Label_Switch_Path.nexthop_ip
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Label_Switch_Path](#/Label_Switch_Path)
IPv4 or IPv6 nexthop ip address for the Label Switch Path.

parameters.name: Label_Switch_Path.type
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Label_Switch_Path](#/Label_Switch_Path)
Type of Label Switch Path 'transport' : Indicates the Label Switch is used for transport 'l3-vpn' : Indicates that the Label Switch Path carries l3-vpn service 'l2-vpn' : Indicates that the Label Switch Path carries l2-vpn service

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
